title: Readable live MCP activity
summary: This release candidate keeps MCP server and tool names readable while approved actions stream into a conversation, as well as after page refresh. Desktop installers remain unsigned manual downloads; automatic application updates are not published for this version.
items: Preserved recorded MCP display names when live tool events are first received or merged with later updates, including thin events that do not repeat display metadata.
Included MCP display names in the early tool events promoted from model messages. Execution aliases, approval behavior and model routing remain unchanged.
Added regressions for first, late and partial display events, including checks that metadata from different tool calls is not mixed.
